tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250snyan brgyud phur pa'i tshe sgrub kyi dmigs bzlas gter gzhung las khol phyung ni/ 1$0000300bdag mdun badz+ra ku mā ra'i: thugs nas 'od zer mkha' khyab 'phros: pho nya bcu gnyis las la bskul: srid pa gsum gyi gting dkrugs te: bla tshe chad nyams yar pa bkug: snod bcud dwangs ma dbang med bsdus: ye shes chen po'i gzi byin gyis: mya ngan 'das pa'i rnam grol dbyig: theg le gcig tu bskyil pa las: mi 'gyur rtag pa'i srog thob gyur:

ces mos la sgrub sngags/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pa'i sham du/ badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā: zhes sbyar ba ci nus su bzlas mthar mda' dar g.yab ste tshe 'gugs bskul ba ni/ oṃ: dang por thugs bskyed rjes su dgongs: bar du grub pa'i rtags mtshan dbyung: tha ma rig 'dzin bdag cag gis: rtse gcig bsnyen pa chud ma gson: sku gsung thugs kyi gzi byin skyed: yon tan phrin las cho 'phrul ston: pho nya sprul pas 'jig rten khengs: snod kyi dwangs ma bcud kyi dpal: 'khor 'das kun gyi tshe sdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la khug: sgo gsum thig le'i dbyings su stims: bla tshe chad nyams yar pa gsos: tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swā hā: ces sgrub sngags la tshe sham sbyar ba bcas bya/ spros pas srid zhir khyab pa'i tshe: bsdus pas thig le nyag gcig klong: 'pho 'gyur med par rgyas btab pas: ye shes mchog gi tshe 'grub shog: dz+nyā na badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa a a: zhes dang ye dhar bcas brjod la rgyas gdab bya'o/// /
